opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK (or asylum seekers), not eligible for government tuition fee support, and enrolled on (or holding an unconditional offer for) an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution. Second-degree applicants must meet additional reskilling criteria.
opportunities.summary: Funding for individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for Scottish Government tuition fee support to study for a first undergraduate degree (or a second degree in limited subject areas) at a Scottish university. Covers tuition fees up to £1,820 per year.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie-Morgan Scholarship

amount.raw: Full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus an additional living-cost bursary of £1,200.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households who have been accepted onto the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants (delivered by Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh and University of Edinburgh), ordinarily resident in Scotland, entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, and who have not already obtained a postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: A scholarship developed in partnership with the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh (RBGE) that covers full tuition fees and a £1,200 living-cost bursary for Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households undertaking the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants, to widen participation in postgraduate plant science and botany study.
